text: At the behest of the Wilson Village BIA, I am here to kindly request that Transportation Services conduct a staff report on the feasibility of on-street parking along Wilson Avenue between Murray Road and Dufferin Street during off peak hours. It is so that business along the aforementioned stretch of Wilson Avenue can have additional parking for customers without disrupting rush hour traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation Services to conduct a staff report on the feasibility of on-street parking along Wilson Avenue between Murray Road and Dufferin Street during off peak hours (i.e. 9:00am to 3:00pm and 6:00pm to 12:00am Monday to Friday and all day on weekends/statutory holidays).
